_comment: Manual overrides per species, keyed by scientific name: {"include": [inat photo ids, forced in first, in this order], "exclude": [inat photo ids never chosen], "description": {"summary", "field_marks", "size", "habitat": text written over the Wikipedia-derived fields}, "limit": N cleared candidates to consider instead of the build's --limit, "trust_article": true to take a Wikipedia article whose lead names neither the BirdNET binomial nor the BirdNET common name, "sounds": {"song": "xc-<nr>", "call": "xc-<nr>" pinned first, "exclude": [recording ids never chosen], "xeno_canto_name": the name xeno-canto files the species under, "accept": [species BirdNET may hear instead, the other half of a split]}, "art": {"reference": inat photo id: the pack photo pack art is painted from, instead of the best-lit one (#57); "setting": what pack art paints the bird on, one of perch, trunk, flight, ground, rock, shore, wade or water, from what its reference shows (any perch off the ground is a branch; prompts v10); "length_cm": the bird's length, which sizes the setting, where the description gives none}}. Photo ids are in the pack's report.json and LICENSE.
